title: An algebraic extension embeds into an algebraically closed extension
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $L$ a field extension of $K$ which is algebraic over $K$ (every element of $L$ is a root of a nonzero polynomial with coefficients in $K$), and $\Omega$ an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure] together with a field homomorphism $\varphi:K\to\Omega$. Then there is a field homomorphism $\psi:L\to\Omega$ with $\psi|_K=\varphi$. In particular, for an algebraic closure $\overline K$ of $K$ every homomorphism of $K$ into an algebraically closed field extends to $\overline K$.
